text: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt:
The lion has roared! Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken [to the prophets]! Who can but prophesy?

Proclaim on the fortresses in Ashdod (Philistia) and on the citadels in the land of Egypt, and say, "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see the great confusion within her and the oppressions and abuse of authority in her midst.
For they do not know how to do right," says the LORD, "these who store up violence and devastation [like treasures] in their strongholds."
"An adversary (Assyria), even one surrounding the land, Shall pull down your strength from you And your fortresses will be looted."
"And I shall tear down the winter house with the summer house; And the houses of ivory shall also perish And the great houses shall come to an end," Says the LORD.
